text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Few Umamusume from the Triple Tiara route 
have ever claimed victory in the Yasuda 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the Takarazuka Kinen is right 
around the corner. Yet if it's Sweep 
Tosho...! Carrying the spectators' high 
hopes, she heads into the race.
